keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"keep_inline_images_in":["a"]}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<a href="https://example.com/file.pdf"><img src="pdf.png"><p>Download PDF</p></a>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
